description:
Embark on a journey through the key concepts of quantum computing and fascinating world of quantum enigmas. These courses are designed to provide you with a deeper understanding of quantum computing principles and techniques through the exploration and solving of intriguing quantum enigmas.

 

These courses were developed in collaboration with Institut quantique de l’Université de Sherbrooke.

 

What you’ll learn

After completing Quantum Enigmas, you should be able to:

  • Differentiate between classical and quantum computers by identifying their fundamental differences, including computational principles and technologies
  • Describe the measurement process of a qubit in quantum computing and the outcomes and implications of measuring a qubit
  • Identify the roles and significance of quantum logic gates in quantum computing
  • Describe how quantum logic gates contribute to quantum information processing
  • Differentiate between various types of quantum gates, their unique functionalities, and application in quantum computing systems
  • Describe how to use the IBM quantum composer to manipulate qubits, demonstrating the process of placing a qubit into superposition, entangling qubits, and applying different types of quantum gates to control and manipulate quantum states effectively

About this learning activity

In this course, you will dive into the perplexing and mind-bending concepts that define the quantum world. Through a series of illuminating videos and exercises, you will unravel the fascinating nature of quantum computing, exploring topics such as superposition, entanglement, and the mysterious behavior of qubits. Whether you are a curious science enthusiast or a budding physicist, this course will expand your understanding of quantum phenomena and leave you awestruck by the wonders of the quantum realm.

After completing this course, you should be able to do the following:

  • Differentiate between classical and quantum computers by identifying their fundamental differences, including computational principles and underlying technologies
  • Describe the measurement process of a qubit in quantum computing and the outcomes and implications of measuring a qubit
  • Identify the roles and significance of quantum logic gates in quantum computing
  • Describe how quantum logic gates contribute to quantum information processing
  • Differentiate between various types of quantum gates, their unique functionalities, and application in quantum computing systems
  • Describe how to use the IBM quantum composer to manipulate qubits, demonstrating the process of placing a qubit into superposition, entangling qubits, and applying different types of quantum gates to control and manipulate quantum states effectively

About this learning activity

In this course, quantum enigmas will serve as your gateway to understanding complex and exciting applications. Each enigma presents a thought-provoking puzzle that not only challenges your problem-solving skills, but also introduces you to the real-world implications of quantum algorithms and technologies. You’ll explore quantum principles illustrating how superposition, entanglement, and interference can be harnessed to solve intricate problems, find optimal solutions, and push the boundaries of what’s possible with computation.

 

Through a series of engaging enigmas and hands-on challenges, you will expand your understanding of quantum computing. You will delve into advanced topics such as Grover's algorithm, quantum optimization, and multi-qubit entanglement. By the end of this course, you will have a solid grasp of these advanced concepts and how they can be applied to real-world problems.

 

Whether you're an experienced quantum explorer or just beginning to unravel the mysteries of quantum computing, this course will challenge and deepen your understanding of advanced quantum concepts. Prepare to be fascinated by the power of quantum problem-solving as you tackle each enigma.

 

After completing this course, you should be able to do the following:

  • Differentiate between various types of quantum gates, their unique functionalities, and application in quantum computing systems
  • Analyze and use quantum algorithms for problem solving
  • Use quantum concepts for optimization and decision making
  • Construct and simulate quantum circuits for practical applications
  • Describe quantum probability and measurement
  • Combine quantum techniques and concepts to solve complex problems

title: Quantum Computing - Advanced
description:
We experience the benefits of classical computing every day. However, there are challenges that today’s systems will never be able to solve. For problems above a certain size and complexity, we don’t have enough computational power on Earth to tackle them. To stand a chance at solving some of these problems, we need a new kind of computing. Universal quantum computers leverage the quantum mechanical phenomena of superposition and entanglement to create states that scale exponentially with number of qubits, or quantum bits

In this channel you learn about the learn about the basics of Quantum Computing, learn about Qiskit, an open-source quantum computing software development framework, and conduct hands-on tutorial exercises.
